tiktok.text:
Georgetown is 2nd 👀 Which Big East school has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk? Send this to your friend at another Big East school.

#depaul #georgetown #marquette #collegelife #collegefood

Michigan is 2nd 👀 Which state flagship university has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk? Send this to a friend at their state's flagship.

#ucberkeley #michigan #rutgers #collegelife #collegefood

Delaware State is 2nd 👀 Which HBCU has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk? Send this to your friend at another HBCU.

#howard #delawarestate #famu #collegelife #collegefood

BU is 7th 👀 Which college in Boston has the most restaurants within a 10-minute walk? Send this to your friend at another Boston college.

#suffolk #emerson #berklee #collegelife #collegefood

thread:
DePaul has more restaurants within a 10-minute walk of campus than Georgetown, Marquette and St. John's combined.

10 of the 11 Big East schools:

1. DePaul: 488
2. Georgetown: 52
3. Marquette: 44
4. St. John's: 43
5. Seton Hall: 18
6. UConn: 17
7. Creighton: 14
8. Xavier: 12
9. Villanova: 7
10. Butler: 4

Places to eat within half a mile of each campus's center, using Overture Maps listings.

Look up any campus, with the closest places first: https://www.savorscout.net/rankings/
